beats.title: Battle opens: Sleep on Cultist Leader and Elite Guard attacks
beats.summary: The group is deep in battle. Stafl casts Sleep on the Cultist Leader while both Elite Guards attack party members — Karsemine is sprayed with corruption and the prone Baergrom takes a critical hit. Meatlings fail follow-up hits and plummet into the depths.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:18-19
anchor_quotes: The group finds themselves deep into the battle.
Stafl decides the best action is to cast Sleep on the Cultist Leader.
Both Elite Guards attack members of the party.
Karsemine is attacked first and sprayed with corruption.

beats.title: Fireball in the center room kills Cultist Leaders and ignites the Meat Pile
beats.summary: Ephanna casts Fireball in the center of the room for massive damage, killing the Cultist Leaders and incinerating the meatlings while the Meat Pile catches fire. Baergrom shoves an Elite Guard over the side, Zora casts Magic Missile on remaining meatlings and the Elite Guard, and Idris charges the Meat Pile.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:21-21
anchor_quotes: Ephanna sees another perfect opportunity for Fireball and again casts it in the center of the room, dealing massive damage.
The Cultist Leaders perish, the meatlings are incinerated and the enormous Meat Pile in the center is now on fire.
Zora, the mage, casts Magic Missile on each of the remaining meatlings and the remaining Elite Guard

beats.title: Meat Pile regenerates and the Wolf's voice begs for release
beats.summary: The room quakes, tendrils swell with energy, and the Meat Pile's flames go out as it appears undamaged. Stalf tries to pull Zora back from the tendrils but they continue dragging her toward the wall. A voice from the Meat Pile — the disgusting head of the Wolf — begs to be released as more meatlings spew out.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:23-23
anchor_quotes: The energy is passed down to the Meat Pile.
The flames go out and it now looks as if it never took any damage at all.
Then a voice coming from the Meat Pile, the disgusting head of the Wolf appears begging for someone to release him as the Meat Pile spews out more meatlings.

beats.title: Cultists ambush from the tunnel and Stafl uses the Peacemaker Fiddle
beats.summary: Bonogo damages an Elite Guard and Caelynn finishes him with Magic Missile while killing a meatling. A group of Cultists emerges from the tunnel and stabs Stafl in the back; Karsemine rescues Zora by slicing through the tendrils. Stafl then uses his Peacemaker Fiddle to cast Song of Shattering, killing the remaining Elite Guard and injuring all the Cultists.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:25-25
anchor_quotes: Suddenly, without warning, Stafl is stabbed in the back by a group of Cultists that have made their way down the tunnel.
Karsemine rushes to her rescue and slices through the tendrils.
Casting Song of Shattering kills the remaining Elite Guard and injures all of the Cultists.

beats.title: Party pushes back the enemy with Shatter and Shield abilities
beats.summary: Ephanna casts Shatter on the large tendril, killing meatlings but weakening the grate. Baergrom plants his shield in the center of the platform for temporary health, Idris advances on the large tendril amid an ominous creak, and Zora severs the tendril with Magic Missile.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:27-27
anchor_quotes: Ephanna casts Shatter on the large tendril and kills several meatlings.
However, the spell damages and weakens the grate.
Zora follows up the attack with Magic Missile, severing the tendril in a spray of goo.

beats.title: Tendrils prioritized as Meat Flies and Cultists are destroyed
beats.summary: The ground shakes and pulses spawn Meat Flies from the Meat Pile. Bonogo kills one, Caelynn Thunderwaves the Cultist group to death, and Karsemine attacks another large tendril with both swords after the group realizes the tendrils are the top priority.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:29-29
anchor_quotes: Again the meat swells and spawns a group of Meat Flies.
Caelynn casts Thunderwave on the group of Cultists, killing them all.
Realising that the tendrils are the top priority Karsemine rushes over to another large tendril and uses both swords to deal major damage.

beats.title: More Cultists arrive; meat flies swarm Bonogo
beats.summary: More Cultists arrive from another tunnel but are stopped by Stafl's Sleep. After Bonogo kills a meat fly, the remaining meat flies all attack him at once; he dodges all but one and takes minor damage. Baergrom uses his shield's ability to provide temporary healing again.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:31-31
anchor_quotes: More Cultists arrive from another tunnel, but don’t get very far into the room before Stafl casts Sleep.
the remaining meat flies all attack at once against him.
Baergrom uses his shield’s ability, providing temporary healing for the team again.

beats.title: Idris falls through the broken grate; Cultist Guard leaps onto the platform
beats.summary: Ephanna's Eldritch Blast and Zora's Magic Missile damage the tendril. Idris steps on the broken grate and falls through, barely hanging on. A Cultist Guard leaps to the central platform, Baergrom intercepts tendril attacks on Ephanna with his shield, and the Cultist Guard hits Bonogo twice for significant damage.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:33-33
anchor_quotes: Idris moves around the center platform to make an attack, but takes a step on the broken grate and falls through, barely hanging on.
One of the Cultist Guards makes an incredible leap across to the central platform, preparing to attack.
The Cultist Guard hits Bonogo with two attacks dealing a significant amount of damage.

beats.title: Caelynn's Snowball and Karsemine's Horde Breaker thin the Cultists
beats.summary: Caelynn casts Snowball on the sleeping Cultist group, killing two instantly, and Karsemine leaps in with Horde Breaker to kill more. Baergrom uses Commander's Strike to have Bonogo deal massive damage to the Meat Pile while Idris climbs back up and Zora casts Magic Missile on the tendril again.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:35-35
anchor_quotes: Caelynn casts Snowball on the sleeping Cultist group, killing 2 of them instantly.
Karsemine then leaps to the remaining Cultists and uses Horde Breaker to kill a few more.
Baergrom lifts up his shield and then uses Commander’s Strike to have Bonogo deal massive damage to the meat pile.

beats.title: Meat Pile spawns a giant centipede-like appendage climbing toward the ceiling
beats.summary: The meat pile spawns a giant, disgusting centipede-like appendage that slowly climbs the side of the room toward the ceiling. Only the ceiling and the adventurers separate the townspeople above from this horrible creature.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:37-37
anchor_quotes: the meat pile spawns a giant disgusting centipede-like appendage that slowly starts to climb up the side of the room towards the ceiling.
The only thing separating the townspeople above and this horrible creature is the ceiling and the group of adventures.

beats.title: Bonogo and Caelynn strike the centipede; Ephanna is pulled onto the meat pile
beats.summary: Bonogo leaps onto the creature with his dagger and Caelynn's Snowball damages and slows it while destroying the last tendril. The Guard grabs Ephanna and pulls them onto the meat pile but misses the attack. Karsemine kills both meat flies with Horde Breaker, and Stafl uses a potion then his final spell slot for one more Sleep.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:39-39
anchor_quotes: Bonogo leaps onto the creature, slicing with his dagger.
The Guard grabs Ephanna and pulls them on to the meat pile, but misses their attack.
Stafl uses a potion to heal some damage and then uses his final spell slot to cast one more Sleep spell on the remaining meat flies and meatlings.

beats.title: Centipede climbs toward the ceiling as Idris is saved by Feather Fall
beats.summary: A meat fly transforms into a meat mound and hits Karsemine hard while Ephanna is pulled in further. Baergrom lands a critical hit and follows with Action Surge, Idris and Zora attack but cannot stop the centipede's advance, Bonogo lands a massive opportunity attack, and Idris falls off — saved by Caelynn's Feather Fall.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:41-41
anchor_quotes: One of the meat flies that was still active ends its transformation and turns into a meat mound and attacks Karsemine for big damage.
Because it begins to move Bonogo gets in an opportunity attack for massive damage.
Idris falls off the creature, likely receiving major damage, but is saved by Caelynn casting Feather Fall.

beats.title: Back-and-forth battle leaves the city's fate in question
beats.summary: The recap closes on the battle's see-saw nature and poses the question of whether the heroes will stop the centipede in time to save the city.
